combing.line: Well my hair is a-yeller' and I'm always a-combing
stanza: My name is Loretta, but I prefer Lottie
I'm closing in on my fifteenth year
If you think you have seen a pair of eyes more green
Then you sure haven't see them around here
Well my hair is a-yeller' and I'm always a-combing
De toute façon j'ai un flingue
Alors rangez vos seringues
Ou je monte à fond la bastringue
De Paris à Saint-Domingue

foaming.line: I got a pretty little mouth underneath all the foaming
stanza: Yes, it is I, Lottie, The Curse Of Millhaven
I've struck horror in the heart of this town
Like my eyes ain't green and my hair ain't yeller'
It's more like the other way around
I got a pretty little mouth underneath all the foaming

gloaming.line: They were strolling in the gloaming
stanza: They were strolling in the gloaming
Where the roses were in bloom
A soldier and his sweetheart brave and true
And their hearts were filled with sorrow
For their thoughts were of tomorrow
As she pinned a rose upon his coat of blue
But I'll spend my days
In endless roaming
Soft is the grass
My bed is free

wyoming.line: It's a cold wind blowing, Wyoming
stanza: 'Western skies' don't make it right
'Home of the brave' don't make no sense
I've seen a scarecrow wrapped in wire
Left to die on a high ridge fence
It's a cold, cold wind
It's a cold, cold wind
It's a cold wind blowing, Wyoming
From the town of Lincoln, Nebraska
With a sawed-off .410 on my lap
Through the badlands of Wyoming
I killed everything in my path
